title: Does AI break the case for broad index investing? Rent decay, private capital, and deflation: replication package
description: Replication package for the article forthcoming in The Journal of Beta Investment Strategies. Code and input data that reproduce every number in the article's empirical exhibits: return on invested capital by scarcity layer, sector composition of US, developed ex-US, emerging and world markets, returns of capitalization-weighted, equal-weighted, AI-themed and bottleneck funds since the release of ChatGPT, S&P 500 replacements and concentration, sensitivity of fund returns to the 10-year real yield, and real asset returns by inflation regime, 1928 to 2025. The article text is copyright PMR and is not included. Third-party input data remain the property of their sources and are included for replication only; the code is MIT-licensed.
